details:
GreenFarmify

Turning Climate Data into Confident Agricultural Decisions

What is GreenFarmify?

GreenFarmify is a technology-based agricultural decision-support tool designed to help farmers adapt to the growing mismatch between traditional agricultural calendars and changing climate patterns.

As rainfall seasons become increasingly variable, planting periods that once aligned with predictable weather conditions may no longer be suitable. This creates uncertainty for farmers, who must make important decisions based on environmental conditions that are becoming harder to anticipate.

But having access to data is not enough. Data is only valuable when you can understand it and put it into practice.

GreenFarmify bridges this gap by transforming NASA environmental data and local soil information into practical, understandable recommendations that support agricultural planning.

How does it work?

GreenFarmify integrates NASA satellite and meteorological data with local soil information to provide a broader understanding of agricultural conditions.

The platform retrieves NASA soil moisture information through APIs, incorporating environmental data into its analysis. This information is complemented by simulated sensor readings, organized in JSON format, representing measurements that could be collected from sensors installed in agricultural fields.

By connecting climate conditions with soil characteristics, GreenFarmify aims to generate personalized recommendations, including suitable crops, planting periods, and crop rotation strategies.

The goal is to turn complex environmental information into useful insights that farmers can consider when planning their agricultural activities.

Our Value: Supporting Farmers, Not Replacing Their Practices

We don't change the way farmers work. We help them work with greater confidence.

GreenFarmify is designed to complement existing agricultural practices and fit into farmers' current workflows, rather than replace their knowledge, experience, or decision-making processes.

We recognize that farmers already have established ways of understanding and working with their land. Our purpose is to provide an additional source of information that helps them evaluate conditions, consider alternatives, and make better-informed decisions.

By making environmental data easier to interpret and apply, GreenFarmify seeks to reduce uncertainty and give farmers greater confidence when planning their crops.

Benefits and Expected Impact

GreenFarmify aims to create value through three main areas:

  • Better-informed decisions: Connect climate and soil information to support more appropriate planting periods and crop selection.
  • Soil conservation: Encourage crop management and rotation strategies that consider soil characteristics and help preserve its fertility.
  • Climate resilience: Help farmers adapt their agricultural planning to changing rainfall patterns and environmental conditions.

Ultimately, the project seeks to improve agricultural planning, promote more efficient resource use, and strengthen the resilience of farming communities, particularly in regions where agriculture depends heavily on seasonal rainfall.

Pilot Study

To explore the project's potential, we propose a pilot study inspired by the traditional milpa system, using three crops: maize, lima bean (ib), and velvet bean (Mucuna).

The study will consider different crop association and rotation scenarios, evaluating soil conditions and changes in relevant soil indicators.

This pilot will help explore how climate and soil information can support crop management decisions while considering regional crops and agricultural practices.

Tools and Technologies

GreenFarmify was developed using several programming languages and technologies:

  • HTML: Interface structure.
  • JavaScript: Interactive elements and information processing.
  • C# and Java: Additional programming languages incorporated into the development process.
  • Visual Studio Code: Development environment.
  • GitHub: Code repository and version control.

For data integration, the project uses APIs to retrieve NASA soil moisture information. Since physical sensors were not available during this development stage, sensor readings were simulated and organized in JSON format to represent a local sensor database.

Creativity and Design Approach

GreenFarmify's innovation lies in connecting space-based environmental information with the everyday needs of local agriculture.

Rather than treating climate and soil as separate factors, the project brings them together to provide a more complete understanding of field conditions.

Its design considers changing rainfall patterns, the gap between traditional planting calendars and current climate conditions, soil characteristics, regional crops, and existing agricultural practices.

GreenFarmify turns complex environmental data into understandable information, helping farmers anticipate, adapt, and make more confident agricultural decisions.

From Space to Soil. From Data to Decisions.
